title: KarbarPro platform overview
text: KarbarPro is InariSoftLabs' cloud-based shop and business management software for small and medium businesses. It brings sales, purchases, stock, cash, expenses and daily accounts into one platform.

title: KarbarPro business types
text: KarbarPro is intended for grocery and retail shops, pharmacies, printing and photocopy shops, computer and mobile-service shops, and local multi-service businesses in Bangladesh.

title: KarbarPro sales workflow
text: KarbarPro supports fast sales entry with cash or due sales, discounts, invoice and receipt printing. Marketing may describe a shop workflow without claiming a screenshot contains a particular transaction.

title: KarbarPro stock management
text: KarbarPro supports purchase entry, current stock tracking, low-stock alerts, stock adjustment and product-wise profit tracking.

title: KarbarPro pharmacy stock support
text: For pharmacy workflows, KarbarPro supports batch-based stock tracking and low-stock and expiry alerts. Do not claim these are relevant to every shop unless the post is specifically about a pharmacy.

title: KarbarPro customer dues
text: KarbarPro includes customer dues and supplier payables. Posts may describe keeping due amounts visible and following up on collections without inventing balances, customers or payment results.

title: KarbarPro daily accounts
text: KarbarPro helps businesses manage cash, expenses and daily accounts. Its product materials describe separate cash, MFS and flexiload balances for relevant businesses.

title: KarbarPro business reports
text: KarbarPro includes a business dashboard and reports. Marketing can describe checking day-to-day business figures, but must not invent revenue, profit, growth or savings figures.

title: KarbarPro buy-sell-account workflow
text: A documented KarbarPro workflow is: enter purchases and track stock and suppliers; make a sale with cash or due and print a receipt; then review sales, due, expenses and daily account information from the same system.

title: KarbarPro practical value
text: Approved KarbarPro copy can say it helps Bangladeshi shop owners manage sales, inventory, accounts, MFS and flexiload balances without depending on a paper ledger or complicated software. Do not promise error-free work or specific business outcomes.

title: KarbarPro content pillar
text: Approved angles include a shopkeeper checking customer dues before a busy period, a quick sale entry, stock awareness before purchasing, daily expense tracking, or a clearer daily cash view. Always use KarbarPro facts and shop/business language; never use LabLink, patient, diagnostic report or medical workflow language.
